description: Page fetch. Send a public URL; returns the page title and its main content as clean Markdown or plain text, with navigation, scripts and ads removed. Use to read an article, docs page or listing. Not for pages behind logins, PDFs or images; no JavaScript rendering. Reads the first 1 MB of a page. Social networks (Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, X, Reddit, YouTube, TikTok and similar) are refused. Typical response under 2 s. Failed calls are not charged. Costs $0.0099 (USDC, x402).

format.description: markdown keeps headings, links and lists; text is plain.

max_chars.description: Cut the returned content at this many characters.

url.description: Public http or https page to read.
